an10.223:1.4: They steal, encourage others to steal, and approve of stealing;
an10.223:1.5: they commit sexual misconduct, encourage others to commit sexual misconduct, and approve of sexual misconduct;
an10.223:1.6: they use false speech, encourage others to use false speech, and approve of false speech;
an10.223:1.7: they use backbiting speech, encourage others to use backbiting speech, and approve of backbiting speech;
an10.223:1.8: they use harsh speech, encourage others to use harsh speech, and approve of harsh speech;
an10.223:1.9: they use nonsensical speech, encourage others to use nonsensical speech, and approve of nonsensical speech;
an10.223:1.10: they’re covetous, encourage others to be covetous, and approve of covetousness;
an10.223:1.11: they’re malicious, encourage others to be malicious, and approve of malice;
an10.223:1.12: they have wrong view, encourage others to have wrong view, and approve of wrong view—
an10.223:2.4: They abstain from stealing, encourage others to abstain from stealing, and approve of abstaining from stealing;
an10.223:2.5: they abstain from sexual misconduct, encourage others to abstain from sexual misconduct, and approve of abstaining from sexual misconduct;
an10.223:2.6: they abstain from false speech, encourage others to abstain from false speech, and approve of abstaining from false speech;
an10.223:2.7: they abstain from backbiting speech, encourage others to abstain from backbiting speech, and approve of abstaining from backbiting speech;
an10.223:2.8: they abstain from harsh speech, encourage others to abstain from harsh speech, and approve of abstaining from harsh speech;
an10.223:2.9: they abstain from nonsensical speech, encourage others to abstain from nonsensical speech, and approve of abstaining from nonsensical speech;
an10.223:2.10: they’re contented, encourage others to be contented, and approve of contentment;
an10.223:2.11: they’re kind-hearted, encourage others to be kind-hearted, and approve of kind-heartedness;
an10.223:2.12: they have right view, encourage others to have right view, and approve of right view—
